title: About Pai
text: Pai (Ramer Pailou Nuñeza) is a Software & Product Engineer based in the Philippines who brings legacy systems back to life as modern, secure web applications.
Pai has 11+ years building web apps across HRIS, hospitality and intellectual property.

title: This portfolio site
text: This portfolio is an Angular 18 app written in TypeScript, styled with Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap, and hosted on Netlify.

The loading animation uses GSAP, the planet and repair robot are hand-built SVG animations, and this assistant runs entirely in your browser: it searches Pai's data and builds answers from it, with no AI service involved.

title: Pai's resume
text: Pai's full resume covers 11+ years of roles, projects and skills. Open it below, or see the Experience section for each role.

title: How Pai works
text: Understand the problem first. Before writing code, Pai gathers requirements, shapes and maintains the user stories, and plans the work.
Legacy rebuilds are Pai's niche, but every project gets the same approach.

title: What Pai is looking for
text: Legacy system modernization projects, senior C# / .NET and product engineering roles, and API, backend and database-heavy systems.

title: Working remotely
text: Pai is based in the Philippines (UTC+8) and works remotely with international teams, including Australian clients.
